title: 第1章 剑骨惊变第2章 剥骨之刑
lines: 青岚宗，演武广场。
今日的宗门大典，气氛热烈得有些灼人。
万丈青天之下，旌旗招展，身着统一青色服饰的弟子们如潮水般汇聚，人头攒动，目光皆炽热地投向广场中央那座高耸的黑色测灵石碑。
喧嚣声、议论声、灵兽嘶鸣声交织在一起，汇成一股庞大的声浪，冲击着每个人的耳膜。
云澈站在人群的边缘，与这鼎沸的盛景格格不入。
他身姿挺拔，面容清俊，只是那袭洗得有些发白的旧袍，以及眉宇间难以化开的沉郁，让他像是一滴误入沸水的冰，孤独而冷寂。
周围投来的目光复杂难明，有轻蔑，有怜悯，也有毫不掩饰的幸灾乐祸。
他恍若未觉，只是静静站着，清澈的眼眸深处，藏着一丝不易察觉的黯淡，以及一丝……未曾完全熄灭的火苗。
曾几何时，他才是这舞台中央最耀眼的存在。
宗主之子，天赋卓绝，年纪轻轻便触摸到剑师的门槛，更有与宗门第一美人苏清瑶的婚约，可谓集万千宠爱于一身。
然而，一年前，身为宗主的父亲云啸天探索上古剑域裂隙，神秘失踪，生死不明。
代宗主云海，就是他的叔父上位。
自那以后，云澈的修为便诡异地停滞不前，甚至隐隐倒退，从云端天骄跌落凡尘，成了人口中的“废物”
唉！
世态炎凉，莫过于此。
“肃静！”
一声蕴含威严的沉喝如同惊雷，压下了广场所有的嘈杂。
代宗主云海，一身紫袍，面容威严，缓步登上高台。
他目光如电，扫视全场，最终在云澈身上微微一顿，带着一种难以言喻的冷漠，迅速移开。
“现在、我宣布，宗门大典开始！
检测弟子资质，扬我青岚之威！”
仪式按部就班地进行，弟子们依次上前，将手掌按在测灵石碑上，激发或强或弱的光芒，引来看台上长老们或赞许或平淡的点评。
但所有人都知道，今日的重头戏，并非他们。
终于，司仪长老高声唱喏，声音因激动而微微颤抖：“下一个，云昊！”
全场瞬间安静下来，落针可闻。
一道身影，龙行虎步，自信满满地越众而出。
正是云昊。
他一身华贵锦袍，面容与云澈有几分相似，却更多了几分阴鸷与张扬。
他嘴角噙着一抹若有若无的笑意，目光扫过人群，在与云澈对视的刹那，那笑意更深，带着毫不掩饰的挑衅。
云澈的心，猛地一沉。
“完犊子、大事不好”
云昊径直走到测灵石碑前，并未立刻伸手，而是回头，望向看台某处，与端坐其上的苏清瑶视线交汇。
content_en:
Qinglan Sect, Martial Arts Plaza.
Today's sect ceremony was filled with a warm and scorching atmosphere.
Under the vast blue sky, flags were fluttering, and disciples dressed in uniform blue uniforms gathered like a tide. The crowds were crowded, and their eyes were blazing towards the towering black spirit-testing stone tablet in the center of the square.
The noise, discussion, and the screams of spiritual beasts intertwined together to form a huge sound wave that impacted everyone's eardrums.
Yun Che stood on the edge of the crowd, incompatible with this bustling scene.
He has a tall and straight posture and a handsome face. However, the old robe that has been washed a little white and the gloominess between his eyebrows make him like a drop of ice that has accidentally fallen into boiling water, lonely and cold.
The looks around him were complex and difficult to understand, ranging from contempt to pity to unabashed gloating.
He seemed unaware and just stood quietly. In the depths of his clear eyes, there was an imperceptible dimness and a trace of... a fire that had not been completely extinguished.
Once upon a time, he was the most dazzling presence in the center of the stage.
The son of the sect master is extremely talented and has reached the threshold of being a swordsman at a young age. He is also engaged to the sect's most beautiful woman, Su Qingyao, and is loved by all.
However, a year ago, Yun Xiaotian, the father of the sect leader, disappeared mysteriously while exploring the cracks in the ancient sword domain. His life and death are unknown.
Yun Hai, the acting sect leader, was his uncle who came to the throne.
Since then, Yun Che's cultivation has strangely stagnated, and even faintly regressed. He fell from being a genius in the clouds to the mortal world, and became what people call "trash"
Alas!
There is nothing better than this when the world is so hot and cold.
"Quiet!"
A majestic shout was like thunder, suppressing all the noise in the square.
The acting sect leader Yun Hai, dressed in purple robes and with a majestic face, slowly climbed onto the high platform.
His eyes were like lightning, and he scanned the whole place. Finally, he paused slightly at Yun Che, and quickly moved away with an indescribable indifference.
"Now, I announce that the sect's grand ceremony has begun!
Test the disciple's qualifications and promote my power, Qinglan! "
The ceremony was carried out step by step. The disciples stepped forward one by one and pressed their palms on the spirit-testing stone tablet, stimulating strong or weak light, which attracted either approval or indifferent comments from the elders in the audience.
But everyone knew that the highlight of today was not them.
Finally, the elder master of ceremonies sang loudly, his voice trembling slightly with excitement: "Next, Yun Hao!"
The whole place fell silent instantly, and you could hear a pin drop.
A figure, walking like a dragon or a tiger, stepped out from the crowd confidently.
It was Yun Hao.
He was dressed in a luxurious brocade robe, and his face was somewhat similar to Yun Che's, but he was more sinister and flamboyant.
There was a faint smile on the corner of his mouth, and his eyes swept across the crowd. The moment he looked at Yun Che, his smile became even deeper, with unabashed provocation.
Yun Che's heart suddenly sank.
"It's a big deal, you're done."
Yun Hao walked straight to the spirit-testing stone tablet. He did not reach out immediately, but turned back and looked somewhere in the stands, where his eyes met Su Qingyao who was sitting on it.
